title: Students and teachers can save 71% with this Adobe Creative Cloud Pro deal
excerpt: Eligible students and teachers can save over 70% on a year of Adobe Creative Cloud Pro.
content_html:
Written by Lillian Brown

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

edited by Sarah Saril

It's no secret that Adobe Creative Cloud Pro can get pricey, but an education deal can help eligible students and teachers save big time. The Adobe deal discounts a year of Creative Cloud Pro by 71%.

The Adobe Creative Cloud Pro annual deal is available in two forms. Eligible customers can elect to pay for a year of service in monthly installments ($20 a month instead of $70 a month for 12 months) or a full year up-front ($240 instead of $780). Either way, you'll be paying the same amount year-over-year.
Adobe Creative Cloud Pro

Adobe Creative Cloud Pro unlocks access to Adobe's best apps, including Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, Premiere, and more. Students and teachers can save on a year of service.

Just keep in mind that these are one-year contracts exclusively for teachers and students over the age of 13. After the introductory year, subscriptions will renew at $40 a month for 12 months or $480 for a year (still discounted rates) for those eligible, unless you change or cancel your plan before then. Students and teachers can remain on the plan as long as they're still eligible.

This is a stellar deal on an expensive but often necessary service. You can learn more about the full suite of offerings in Adobe Creative Cloud Pro below.

FAQ

What's included in Adobe Creative Cloud Pro?

Adobe Creative Cloud Pro subscriptions offer access to over 20 apps, including Photoshop, InDesign, Premiere, Illustrator, Audition, Character Animator, After Effects, and Acrobat Reader. Subscriptions also unlock access to Adobe Firefly creative AI features for images, video, and audio. Subscribers will get 4000 monthly generative credits.

Who is eligible for this deal?

The deal is available for eligible students 13 and older, as well as teachers. Customers will need to verify their eligibility (using a school-issued email address, school ID card, report card, transcript, or other proof).

What if I'm not a student or teacher?

Even if you're not a student or teacher, there's still a chance to save on Adobe Creative Cloud Pro (although the deal isn't quite as sweet). New subscribers can save 50% on their first three months of Adobe Creative Cloud Pro. The deal, which is an annual subscription billed in monthly installments, knocks the first three months down to $35 a month. After that, subscriptions will cost $70 a month.

To explore all Adobe offerings, you can head to the Adobe website. If you're trying to unsubscribe from Adobe, you can check out our guide on how to cancel an Adobe subscription.
